design: Twelve nested player partitions of the same45earlier athletes, using restored five-availability baseline. Not twelve independent studies. Includes original three seeds. All retained; no favorable-seed selection.

results.predictors: Fifteen Combine physical/timed/NGS traits, Combine position and five common source-availability flags. No NFL snap/game covariates. Rookie-eligible cohort target remains conditional on observed NFL participation.
results.selection_scope: Four class-stratified whole-player outer folds; three inner folds select all feature and ridge/PCA options. Selected family uses the entire declared bank, including conventional. No family selected using2025.

duration_combined.interval_scope: Conditional on retained fitted predictions; does not include refitting or multiplicity across adaptive prior experiments
